CHECK (status = 'completed'::text AND completed_at IS NOT NULL OR status <> 'completed'::text AND completed_at IS NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (player_id) REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (source_id IS NULL OR char_length(source_id) >= 1 AND char_length(source_id) <= 160 AND source_id !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)
FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES match_messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES match_rooms(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (message_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(message_ids) >= 1 AND cardinality(message_ids) <= 1000)
FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES match_rooms(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (tournament_bracket_id) REFERENCES tournament_brackets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (synthetic_division = 'Challenge'::text AND synthetic_elo = 1100 OR synthetic_division = 'Main / Pro'::text AND synthetic_elo = 1400)
FOREIGN KEY (player_id) REFERENCES ironclad_private.staging_synthetic_uat_players(player_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (registration_id) REFERENCES registrations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (tournament_id) REFERENCES tournaments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (player_id) REFERENCES ironclad_private.staging_synthetic_uat_players(player_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (registration_id) REFERENCES registrations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (tournament_bracket_id) REFERENCES tournament_brackets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (tournament_id) REFERENCES tournaments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (player_id) REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (NULLIF(btrim(clerk_user_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND length(clerk_user_id) <= 255)
FOREIGN KEY (privacy_document_id) REFERENCES legal_documents(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (terms_accepted IS TRUE AND privacy_acknowledged IS TRUE)
FOREIGN KEY (terms_document_id) REFERENCES legal_documents(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (last_seen_announcement_id, last_seen_published_at) REFERENCES announcements(id, published_at) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (clerk_user_id = btrim(clerk_user_id) AND char_length(clerk_user_id) >= 1 AND char_length(clerk_user_id) <= 255 AND clerk_user_id !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)

CHECK (closed_by_clerk_user_id = btrim(closed_by_clerk_user_id) AND closed_by_clerk_user_id <> ''::text AND char_length(closed_by_clerk_user_id) <= 256)
FOREIGN KEY (tournament_bracket_id) REFERENCES tournament_brackets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (detail IS NULL OR detail = btrim(detail) AND detail <> ''::text AND char_length(detail) <= 500)
CHECK (activation_version = 0 AND activated_at IS NULL AND deadline_at IS NULL OR activation_version > 0 AND activated_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (deadline_at IS NULL OR deadline_at > activated_at)

CHECK (extension_minutes IS NULL AND extension_reason IS NULL AND extended_at IS NULL AND extended_by_clerk_user_id IS NULL OR extension_minutes IS NOT NULL AND extension_minutes >= 1 AND extension_minutes <= 2880 AND NULLIF(btrim(extension_reason), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND length(extension_reason) <= 2000 AND extended_at IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(extended_by_clerk_user_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (generated_bracket_id) REFERENCES generated_brackets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (hold_started_at IS NULL AND hold_released_at IS NULL AND hold_reason IS NULL AND held_by_clerk_user_id IS NULL OR hold_started_at IS NOT NULL AND (hold_released_at IS NULL OR hold_released_at >= hold_started_at) AND NULLIF(btrim(hold_reason), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND length(hold_reason) <= 2000 AND NULLIF(btrim(held_by_clerk_user_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (official_result_submission_id) REFERENCES match_result_submissions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

CHECK (outcome_type IS NULL AND deadline_ruled_at IS NULL OR status = 'completed'::text AND player_one_score IS NULL AND player_two_score IS NULL AND official_result_submission_id IS NULL AND (outcome_type = 'deadline_double_forfeit'::text AND activation_version > 0 AND activated_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND player_one_registration_id IS NOT NULL AND player_two_registration_id IS NOT NULL AND winner_registration_id IS NULL AND deadline_ruled_at IS NOT NULL OR outcome_type = 'automatic_bye'::text AND activation_version = 0 AND activated_at IS NULL AND deadline_at IS NULL AND num_nonnulls(player_one_registration_id, player_two_registration_id) = 1 AND winner_registration_id IS NOT NULL AND winner_registration_id = COALESCE(player_one_registration_id, player_two_registration_id) AND deadline_ruled_at IS NULL OR outcome_type = 'empty_feeder'::text AND activation_version = 0 AND activated_at IS NULL AND deadline_at IS NULL AND player_one_registration_id IS NULL AND player_two_registration_id IS NULL AND winner_registration_id IS NULL AND deadline_ruled_at IS NULL))
FOREIGN KEY (player_one_registration_id) REFERENCES registrations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (player_two_registration_id) REFERENCES registrations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (round_id) REFERENCES bracket_rounds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (winner_registration_id) REFERENCES registrations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

CHECK (description IS NULL OR description = btrim(description) AND char_length(description) >= 1 AND char_length(description) <= 500 AND replace(replace(description, chr(10), ''::text), chr(13), ''::text) !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)
FOREIGN KEY (match_id) REFERENCES tournament_matches(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (title = btrim(title) AND char_length(title) >= 1 AND char_length(title) <= 160 AND title !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)
FOREIGN KEY (tournament_id) REFERENCES tournaments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (url = btrim(url) AND char_length(url) >= 1 AND char_length(url) <= 2048 AND url ~* '^https://[^[:space:][:cntrl:]]+$'::text)
FOREIGN KEY (generated_bracket_id) REFERENCES generated_brackets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (registration_id) REFERENCES registrations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (end_date IS NULL OR start_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date) NOT VALID
CHECK (registration_open_at IS NULL OR registration_close_at IS NULL OR registration_open_at < registration_close_at) NOT VALID
CHECK (registration_close_at IS NULL OR start_date IS NULL OR registration_close_at <= start_date) NOT VALID

CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'voided'::text])) AND terminal_at IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(terminal_reason), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND char_length(terminal_reason) <= 2000 AND NULLIF(btrim(terminated_by_clerk_user_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL OR (status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'voided'::text])) AND terminal_at IS NULL AND terminal_reason IS NULL AND terminated_by_clerk_user_id IS NULL)
